title: In-Person Appointments Moved-Visit Deposits: Appointment Fee History Rate
content:
**Rate note, patient financial services.** For the deposit a moved In-Person Appointments visit requires, the visit type's self-pay booking deposit is raised according to the ledger of the patient's Patient Financial Account, counting no-show fee and late-cancellation fee charges posted with a date of service less than 12 whole months before the payment date:

- **2 or more** such charges: the visit type's self-pay booking deposit, for the deposit the moved visit requires, is doubled (multiplied by 2);
- **exactly 1** such charge: it is raised by half (multiplied by 1.5);
- **none**: it is taken as it stands (multiplied by 1).

Charges of any other kind are not counted. Either kind of appointment fee charge counts as one.

**Illustration (hypothetical, Advanced Imaging Appointment, self-pay booking deposit 250.00, payment dated 2026-10-20).**

| Charges inside the 12 whole months | Multiplier | Raised figure |
|---|---|---|
| none | 1 | 250.00 |
| one no-show fee, date of service 2026-03-03 | 1.5 | 375.00 |
| one no-show fee and one late-cancellation fee | 2 | 500.00 |
| one late-cancellation fee, date of service 2025-09-30 | 1 (outside the window) | 250.00 |
